title: Representations of generalized linear Reedy categories and abelian model structures
summary: In this paper we consider representations of generalized $k$-linear Reedy categories $\underline{\mathscr{C}}$, a common generalization of $k$-linear Reedy categories introduced by Georgiois-Št'ovíček and $k$-linearizations of generalized Reedy categories introduced by Berger-Moerdijk, and construct abelian model structures on $\underline{\mathscr{C}} \text{-}\mathrm{Mod}$. In the first part, we show that $\underline{\mathscr{C}}$ can be viewed as an infinite categorical analogue of standardly stratified algebras.
